transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Yeah, um... I guess I'm here because I just feel like I'm always running hot. Like I can't really shut the motor off. And, uh... it's been getting me into some trouble at the firehouse lately. So I figured I should come in.
Have you been acting on impulse more often than usual?
I'm not sure what you mean by that. Um... I don't think so? I just... do things. I haven't really noticed a change, if that's what you're asking.
Do you often feel restless or fidgety?

Yeah, I guess so. Um... like if I'm sitting in a meeting, my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'll be clicking a pen... just shifting around in the chair. I don't really notice I'm doing it. I just sort of... end up messing with whatever is in front of me.
Do you have difficulty paying attention to details or making careless mistakes?

Yeah, I suppose. Um... mainly with the paperwork. Like, I’ll finish an incident report and think it’s solid. But then the captain will pull me aside... points out I put the wrong unit number, or I missed a time stamp somewhere. Or I skipped some little box they need for the safety review. Just... yeah, that kind of stuff happens.
Do you often find yourself talking more than others in social situations?
I don't know. Not really, I guess. I just... talk when I need to. I don't think I talk more than anyone else.
Do you often feel like you're constantly on the go?

Yeah. I guess... that's sort of why I'm here, actually. I just feel like I'm always running hot. Like I can't really... shut the motor off. And, um... lately, that's been getting me in trouble at the firehouse. So... yeah. I guess I do.
Do you often have trouble staying seated in one place for a long time?

Yeah, I guess. It's... hard to explain. When we have command meetings and I have to just sit there, it feels like... I don't know, like my body is just revving too high. I just get this urge to stand up. Walk the bay, check the rigs... anything but stay planted in that chair. It's just... uncomfortable.
Were you more physically active or restless than your peers when you were a child?

I mean... I guess so. My mom always said I was like this back in grade school, too. I'd... get out of my seat a lot. Blurt things out before the teacher finished asking. I was always losing my homework, too... getting notes sent home. They said I was bright enough to do the work, I just... couldn't stay still long enough to actually do it. So, yeah. I guess it's been a while.
Did you have any problems with behavior or paying attention in school when you were younger?

I think I just said that, but... yeah. Um... my mom always told me I was like this in grade school. Getting up, talking out of turn. Losing my homework. They told her I was smart enough, just... couldn't focus or sit still. So... yes.
Do you often have strong mood swings?
I don't... I don't really know what you mean by that. I guess I get frustrated sometimes, but... no more than anyone else, probably. I wouldn't call it swings. Just... normal stuff.
Did your parents or teachers ever mention that you had significant difficulties with behavior or attention as a young child?
I... didn't I just answer this? Yeah. They did. Like I said, the teachers sent notes home to my mom. I don't really know what else to tell you about it.
Have you experienced these feelings of restlessness and difficulty paying attention your entire life?
Yeah, I guess so. I mean... as far back as I can remember, anyway. It's just always been like this.
Were you more active or restless than the other kids when you were growing up?

I mean... yeah, I guess so. My mom always brings up how I was in grade school. Just... always getting out of my seat, blurting things out in class. Losing my homework. I got decent grades when I actually did the work, but... yeah, there were a lot of notes sent home. So, yeah. I guess I was.
Have these feelings of restlessness and difficulty paying attention caused problems for you in your relationships or at work beyond what you've already mentioned?

Yeah... work, mostly. At the firehouse. It's... well, it's starting to cost me some trust with the guys. 

They actually pulled me into a performance and safety meeting recently. Which is... yeah. I guess the crew just feels like they can't count on me to track the details consistently right now. I was hoping to move up into a leadership spot, but... pretty sure that's slipping away. So. Yeah, it causes problems.
Do you ever find yourself so focused on something that you lose track of everything else around you?
I don't... no, not really. I can't really think of a time I've been that focused on something. It's usually... well, it's usually the opposite for me. So, no.
Do you ever become so absorbed in an activity that you lose track of time?
No, not really. Like I just said... I don't really get absorbed in things like that. It's hard enough just staying on one task for a few minutes. So... no.
Have you had problems with paying attention or making careless mistakes in settings outside of work, such as at home or in social situations?

Outside of work? Um... I don't really know. I don't really track that. 

It's mostly just... work. Like I was saying before. I'll finish an incident report and think it's solid... and then the captain points out I put the wrong unit number. Or I missed a time stamp, or... skipped some little box that matters for the safety review. So... yeah. Mostly just work.
Have these feelings of restlessness and difficulty paying attention caused problems for you in your personal relationships or with friends?
I don't think so. I mean, my friends are mostly guys from the station, so... they're used to how I am. And I don't really have a lot of other relationships right now, so... no, I guess not.
Have you ever had difficulty maintaining a romantic relationship because of your restlessness or difficulty paying attention?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I'm single right now, so... it hasn't really been an issue. I just... I don't really have much time for dating anyway. So, no.
Did your symptoms start when you were a child or did they begin later in life?

I guess... yeah, it's been a while. My mom says I was like this back in grade school. Always out of my seat, blurting things out... losing my homework. Getting notes sent home. She said I was bright enough to do the work, I just... couldn't keep it together, I guess. So, yeah. Since I was a kid.
